title: Protocol for Single-Nucleus Transcriptomics of Diploid and Tetraploid Cardiomyocytes in Murine Hearts
protocol: Transfer 50-100 mg of freshly dissected mouse heart tissue into a 10 cm dish on ice.
Mince the tissue into small pieces (around 1 mm³ cube) with a razor blade washed in ethanol.
Resuspend the minced tissue in 5 mL PBS and transfer into a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 500 × g for 2 min at 20°C–22°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the tissue pellet in 2 mL 1× Red Blood Cell Lysis Buffer.
Vortex the tube for 20 seconds.
Incubate at 20°C–22°C for 2 minutes.
Add 2 mL PBS to stop the lysis.
Centrifuge the sample at 500 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Wash the tissue pellet in 5 mL ice cold PBS.
After centrifugation, resuspend the tissue in 5 mL Lysis Buffer.
Transfer the suspension to a 20 mL Dounce homogenizer on ice.
Homogenize the tissue with a type A pestle on ice for 15–20 strokes.
Take 10 μL of the sample and check under microscope with Trypan blue.
Filter the lysate through a 70 μm strainer.
Pass the filtered lysate over a 40 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the flow-through at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C to pellet nuclei.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant without disturbing the nuclear pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 2 mL Sucrose Buffer.
Aliquot 4 mL Sucrose Buffer into a separate tube.
Transfer the nuclear suspension on top of the 4 mL Sucrose Buffer carefully.
Centrifuge the cushioned suspension at 1,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C to pellet nuclei.
Wash the nuclear pellet with 1 mL Nuclei Storage Buffer.
Centrifuge at 1,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the nuclei in 1 mL Nuclei Storage Buffer and keep on ice.
Divide the nuclear suspension into four tubes labeled "unstained", "PCM1", "Hoechst", and "PCM1+Hoechst".
Add anti-PCM1 antibody at a 1:200 dilution to the "PCM1" and "PCM1+Hoechst" tubes.
Incubate the nuclei on a rotator for 45 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge the "PCM1" and "PCM1+Hoechst" tubes at 1,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Wash the centrifuged nuclei twice with Nuclei Storage Buffer.
Resuspend the washed nuclei in 1 mL Nuclei Storage Buffer.
Add secondary antibody conjugated with Alexa Fluor 647 at a 1:500 dilution to all tubes.
Incubate the nuclei on a rotator for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash the nuclei twice with 1 mL Nucleus Storage Buffer.
Resuspend the washed nuclei in 500 μL 2% BSA/PBS.
Add Hoechst at a 1:2,000 dilution only to "Hoechst" and "PCM1+Hoechst" tubes.
Incubate for 10 min at 20°C–22°C.
Wash the nuclei twice with 1 mL 2% BSA/PBS.
Resuspend the washed nuclei in 500 μL 2% BSA/PBS for FACS.
Sort the nuclei using a cell-sorter (e.g., BD FACSARIA).
Gate single nuclei with the FSC-H versus FCS-W plot and SSC-H versus SSC-W plot to avoid doublets.
Use "unstained" and "PCM1" samples to gate for PCM1+ nuclei.
Use "unstained" and "Hoechst" samples to gate for diploid (2n) and tetraploid (4n) nuclei.
Sort a minimum of 20,000 PCM1+ 2n and PCM1+ 4n nuclei from the "PCM1+Hoechst" sample into 1.5 mL tubes containing 500 μL of 2% BSA/PBS.
Transfer 10 μL of nuclear suspension to a microscope slide and mount with a glass cover slide.
Inspect the integrity and purity of cardiomyocyte nuclei under fluorescent microscope.
Mix 10 μL nuclear suspension with 10 μL Trypan blue.
Take 10 μL of the mixture and count nuclei manually twice using hemocytometer.
Dilute the nuclei to 1,000 nuclei/μL with 2% BSA/PBS.
Immediately load 6,000 nuclei to each reaction mix for single-cell partitioning and reverse transcription following the manufacturer’s instructions from 10X Genomics.
Prepare single-nucleus RNA-sequencing libraries according to the manufacturer’s instructions from 10X Genomics (v2 or v3 chemistry).
Perform sequencing using the 150-bp high output sequencing kit (Illumina), with the following pair-end sequencing settings: Read1, 26 cycles; i7 index, 8 cycles; Read2, 124 cycles.
